name: OtpInput
summary: One-time passcode entry. Row of single-digit cells with auto-advance, backspace-erases-previous, and paste-distribute. Each cell is its own field micro-shell.

value.description: Controlled value as a single string of digits.

onChange.description: Fires with the joined digit string on each cell change.

onComplete.description: Fires once when all cells are filled.

size.description: Default lg — OTP cells benefit from the larger touch target.

groupBy.description: Insert a wider separator after every Nth cell (e.g. groupBy=3 for 3-3 visual grouping).

keyboard: Tab — enter the row, focus the first empty cell
Type digit — fill cell, auto-advance to next
Backspace on empty cell — focus previous cell
Backspace on filled cell — clear cell
Cmd+V / Ctrl+V — paste-distribute one digit per cell from the focused position
rules: inputMode='numeric' so mobile keyboards show the number pad.
autoComplete='one-time-code' on the first cell so iOS/Android can autofill from SMS.
Row wrapped in role=group with an aria-label describing the code purpose.
Each cell aria-labeled with its position ('OTP digit N of M').
Paste-distribute: pasting 'N digits' fills N cells starting at the focused cell.
Validate on the whole row, not per cell.

do: Auto-advance on a valid digit and backspace-erases-previous on Backspace from an empty cell.
Default size to lg — OTP cells benefit from a larger touch target than typical inputs.
Insert a wider separator after every 3 cells when length is 6 (matches how users read the code aloud).
Set autoComplete='one-time-code' so the OS autofills from SMS.
dont: Don't allow non-digit characters — filter on input.
Don't focus the next cell after a paste-fill — focus the LAST filled cell so the user can submit.
Don't disable paste — users paste from email and SMS notifications.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Auto-advance, backspace-erases-prev, paste-distribute, optional 3-3 grouping for 6-digit codes.
